subject: general
question: Which of the following is written by Mulk Raj Anand?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Untouchable**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mulk Raj Anand** is one of the most prominent writers in **Indian English literature**.
 
• His novel **Untouchable**, published in **1935**, is considered a landmark in Indian literature and deals with the theme of **caste discrimination and social injustice**.
 
• The novel revolves around the life of **Bakha**, a young man who belongs to the **untouchable caste**
